the sandwich

bread 1 > filling > bread 2

Build a chain with a character of its own. Bread 1 shapes the incoming sound, an independent Filling adds the transformation, and Bread 2 finishes the result. Link, Mirror or Free the outer controls to explore how the stages work together.

Beta software — now available for macOS and Windows. The Sandwich 1.0.0 is available as an open Mac and Windows beta. Try your own recipes and help us test the controls, presets and level changes. Save a copy of important projects before testing.

signal flow

one idea. three stages.

The Sandwich is designed to be understood from left to right. Bread 1 shapes the incoming signal, the Filling transforms it, and Bread 2 decides how the sound leaves the chain.

01 / prepare

bread 1

Choose a bread effect and shape it with three context-sensitive controls before the centre stage.

→
02 / transform

filling

The independent centre effect is the main sound-design layer, with four controls for movement, colour and texture.

→
03 / finish

bread 2

Use the same effect type as Bread 1, then Link, Mirror or Free the parameter behaviour.

relationship controls

link. mirror. free.

These controls are central to the Sandwich concept because they determine how the two outer stages interact.

LinkBread 2 follows Bread 1 exactly for symmetrical processing around the Filling.
MirrorBread 2 becomes complementary: controls 1 and 2 invert while control 3 keeps the same amount.
FreeBoth outer stages become independent, allowing different settings before and after the Filling.
Copy + SwapMove stored settings between the two bread stages and switch directly into Free mode.
global controls

colour, balance, protect.

Toast adds saturation and colour. Bite is the global dry/wet control. Final output trim and automatic output protection sit after the main effect chain.

Chef’s ChoiceRandomises the recipe when you want the plugin to surprise you.
Save + LoadStore and recall your own .sandwichpreset recipes.
Input + output metersStereo metering with peak indication for keeping the chain under control.
effect palette

familiar ingredients. stranger combinations.

The outer Bread stages share one effect type, while the centre Filling can use its own independent four-control process.

filtercut / shape / amount
drivedrive / bias / amount
chorusrate / depth / mix
echo + delaytime / feedback / spread / mix
granulargrain / motion / feedback / amount
reverbspace / damping / width / amount
lo-firate / bits / dust / amount
smearsize / motion / feedback / amount
ring modfrequency / shape / stereo / amount
wavefoldfolds / symmetry / tone / amount
resonatorpitch / decay / damping / amount
orbitrate / depth / stereo / amount
fast starting points

three recipes to try first.

Start with something useful, then reshape the sandwich from there.

ambient wash

Bread: filter · Mode: mirror · Filling: reverb or granular · Toast low · Bite 40–60%

textured delay

Bread: drive · Mode: link · Filling: delay · Toast medium · Bite 30–50%

experimental motion

Bread: orbit or ring mod · Mode: free · Filling: smear or resonator · Bite 50–75%

why this beta exists

help refine the recipe.

The Sandwich is deliberately being shared before release so users can find problems that only appear in different DAWs, projects and workflows.

We especially want to know whether the Link / Mirror / Free logic is clear, whether gain changes feel controlled and which effect combinations are actually useful in music.
